item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 20/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a southerly airstream, it will be hot with showers over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A trough of low pressure is expected to move across the coast of southern China and bring thundery showers to the region early next week. The associated easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the central part of the South China Sea.
